stance_basis: paraphrase states Commission found Alternate #5 offers least disruptive connection with minimal adverse environmental impacts
summary: Roy Gardetto represented the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission at the public hearing, reading a statement by Commission Chairman Gordon A. King. The Commission expressed support for the Airport Spur, specifically endorsing Alternate #5 as the least disruptive option with minimal adverse environmental impacts. No response was deemed necessary by the document preparers.
complaint_summary: Gardetto read a statement by Commission Chairman Gordon A. King supporting the Airport Spur and endorsing Alternate #5 as the least disruptive connection to the airport with minimal adverse environmental impacts.
summary_quote: Read Statement by Gordon A. King, Chairman of the Milwaukee County Expressway and Transportation Commission. Stated the Commission participated in the development of the Airport Spur and that Alternate #5 appears to offer the least disruptive connection to the airport with minimal adverse environmental impacts.
